title: Neuro-Symbolic Synergy for World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2602.10480v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general-purpose reasoning capabilities, yet they frequently hallucinate when used as world models (WMs), where strict compliance with deterministic transition rules--particularly in corner cases--is essential. In contrast, Symbolic WMs provide logical consistency but lack semantic expressivity. To bridge this gap, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Synergy (NeSyS), a framework that integrates the probabilistic semantic priors of LLMs with executable symbolic rules to achieve both expressivity and robustness. NeSyS alternates training between the two models using trajectories inadequately explained by the other. Unlike rule-based prompting, the symbolic WM contributes candidate-level scores through log-linear reranking, without requiring the LLM to interpret rule text. translated_title: 面向世界建模的神经符号协同方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的通用推理能力，但当其被用作世界模型（WMs）时，经常会产生幻觉，而世界模型需要严格遵守确定性转移规则——尤其是在边缘情况下。相比之下，符号世界模型具有逻辑一致性，但缺乏语义表达能力。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了神经符号协同框架，该框架将LLMs的概率语义先验与可执行的符号规则相结合，以同时实现表达能力和鲁棒性。NeSyS利用一方难以充分解释的轨迹，在两个模型之间交替进行训练。与基于规则的提示方法不同，符号世界模型通过对数线性重排序提供候选级别的评分，而无需LLM解释规则文本。规则引导的采样优先选取符号规则覆盖较弱的状态转移，仅使用35-60%的训练对即可取得（优于基线的）效果。
tldr: 提出NeSyS框架，通过将LLM的概率语义先验与可执行符号规则进行交替训练、对数线性重排序和规则引导采样相结合，在保持语义表达能力的同时确保世界模型的逻辑一致性与鲁棒性。
